research_topic: Improve continual learning by reducing catastrophic forgetting through intelligent task-ordering strategies on standard benchmarks (Split-CIFAR, Permuted-MNIST, Split-ImageNet) using 1–3B parameter models with parameter-efficient adaptation, implementing curriculum learning frameworks based on task similarity and gradient interference to address the 2025 lifelong learning challenge in practical deployment scenarios.
